facts.business: Raconteur Global Resources Limited is in the process of establishing its presence in the mining and natural resources sector, evaluating opportunities in infrastructure supply, construction materials, contract mining, and digital mining services.

auditor.name: M/s A S Bhutani & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-receipt of external balance confirmations (SA 505) and non-provision of depreciation on fixed assets in subsidiary Raconteur Granite Limited. Emphasis of matter on unconfirmed balances and substantial unsecured loans payable (₹60.16 crore) and loans given (₹69.48 crore) indicating material uncertainty.

key_risks: Rising fuel prices, freight costs, electricity tariffs and labour expenses
Regulatory delays in mining leases, environmental clearances, pollution control consents
Lack of skilled manpower and technical execution capability
Non-provision of depreciation on fixed assets in subsidiary
Substantial unsecured loans payable and loans given indicating material uncertainty
